evidence_items.content_summary: Author markers provide semantic hints for priority files, module roles, pipeline steps, claimed novelty, and potential mismatches. Project goal: Enable robust 3D understanding for an LLM while reducing dependence on large-scale 3D paired data.. Paper method goal: Show that the model can use large-scale text-based alignment first, then use limited 3D data to connect point-cloud representations to the language model.. Mainline: Text-first projector alignment -> richer instruction alignment -> point-language transfer via compact point tokens and shared projector.
